_format: Each line is one Chatterbox take. Tokens split on spaces. [shown=spoken] gives a spoken form. Suffix *y = yellow keyword, *r = red keyword. A trailing / ends a caption phrase. fx: brother = narrator pitched up ~3.5 semitones. pause = silence after the line (s).
title: DON'T REPLY Day 1
